purpose: This silver table cleans the bronze OurAirports airports feed into a single typed row per airport, providing a reliable reference dataset for downstream geospatial and airport-lookup consumers.
usage: Consumers should join or filter on id (the declared grain) and use has_scheduled_service to distinguish airports with commercial scheduled service; treat icao_code, gps_code, local_code, home_link, wikipedia_link, keywords, elevation_ft, and municipality as optional and handle nulls explicitly.
limitations: Cleanup could not resolve missing values in local_code (63.7% null), home_link (74.9% null), keywords (68.0% null), icao_code (13.7% null), wikipedia_link (13.1% null), gps_code (5.4% null), elevation_ft (3.7% null), or municipality (4.0% null); these remain nullable rather than imputed, and no duplicate rows were found (duplicate_row_rate 0.0) so no dedupe logic was applied.
